propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy shape (H2 headings, character counts, bullets) rather than the author-guide leaf/container contract, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating maintenance drift and inconsistent enforcement.

AC verification coverage lacks deterministic checking: acceptance criteria must be parsed and each item must be either operator-attested or contain explicit proof clauses (verified by, checked by, verify with), but this is not currently measured.
Plan-review guidance requires placeholder-free Scope/Approach (no TBD, figure out, depends on investigation, etc.), but no deterministic detection rule exists to flag deferred-decision language.
Author-guide and G6 criteria conflict on rejected-alternative requirements: guides request it while G6 explicitly forbids requiring it, creating ambiguity in clarity enforcement.
Leaf plans must declare grounded edit-set with file_impact structure, but current regex-based path detection is not tied to canonical file-impact field or structured scope validation.
